correctness.rationale: For every strict rank chamber the local median selector admits an exact three-edge factorization through cyclic first differences with column (a,1-a-c,c), a,c in {0,1}. Blending uniform moving average yields three coefficients whose absolute sum is at most max(1,3-8theta/3), by checking four indicator patterns. Continuity and finite piecewise-affinity imply the same bound globally. Two separated strict-rank interfaces with finite epsilon input perturbation attain that bound for all n>=6 and all theta in [0,1]. Exact rational proof checks independently verify all rank chambers for n=6,7,8 and witnesses for n=6..23, while the general proof supplies infinite-domain validity.

value.rationale: The 3/4 threshold gives an exact, dimension-uniform nonexpansivity calibration for a classical robust-plus-linear smoothing construction. It resolves a mathematically motivated gap between mean/median endpoint bounds; sharp finite witnesses expose the negative middle-derivative cancellation and show that no smaller averaging weight suffices. The claim is an exact structural fact, not merely a numerical gain or a restated convexity bound.
